page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan, left page (ז א) and right page (ז ה). Each has an upper column of Hebrew-Latin word entries, with a horizontal rule and a lower section below it of two parallel columns. The left page's lower column carries its own heading ז א. The signature Ppp 3 stands at the bottom right.

main_text.l: R. שנא.
הַשְׁפָּלְתָּ [?] depressisti, לְהַשְׁפִּילָה [?]
deprimere, praet. & inf. aphel. R. שפל.
הִשְׁתַּכַּח inventum est,
הִשְׁתַּכְּחָה inventa est, fæm.
הִשְׁתַּכְּחָתְּ inventus es, praet. Ithpeh. cum metathesi.
inveni, הַשְׁכַּחְתִּי invenerunt, הַשְׁכַּחְנוּ [?] invenia-
mus, praet. לְהַשְׁכָּחָה [?]
invenire, inf. aph. R. שכח.
הִתְגַּזַּר excisus est, praet. Ithpeh. f. R. גזר.
הִתְחָרַךְ adustus fuit, praet. Ithpa. R. חרך.
הֵתִיבוֹנָא retulit, הֵתִיב responderunt nobis,
לְהַתְבּוֹתָךְ [?] ad respon-
main_text.p: dendum tibi, praet. 1. pl. aff. & inf. aff. & præf. R. תוב.
main_text.l: הִתְמָלִי repletus fuit, præf. Ithpeh. R. מלא.
הִתְנַבִּי prophetavit, praet. Ithpa. R. נבא.
הִתְנַדְּבוּ sponte offerunt, praet. Ithpah. הִתְנַדְּבוּת spontanea oblatio, No. f. f. R. נדב.
לְהִתְקַטָּלָה ad interficien-dum, inf. Ithpeh. præf. R. קטל.
הִרוֹמַמְתִּי extulisti te, praet. Ithpah. R. רום.
הִתְחַרְחֲצוּ confisi sunt, praet. Ithpeh. R. רחץ.
הִתְקַנָּה confirmatus fui, praet. Hoph. R. תקן.
זְאִין trementes, part. præf. pl. peh. R. זוע.
זַבְנִין redimentes, part. peh. pl. m. R. זבן.
זְהִירִין moniti, No. vel part. praet. pl. R. זהר.
זִיו splendor meus, זִיוָה ejus, זִיוֵי splendores mei, זִיוִין [?]

page.notes: The Hebrew letters are copied as far as they can be read at this scale. Those marked [?] are uncertain, including the vowel points and the lower-right entries. The top-right page number is an uncertain Hebrew numeral. The rule divides the upper columns from the lower section. The Hebrew catchword at the bottom right is doubtful. The scan is a Google digitisation with no stamps to omit.
